captions.detailed: A large Dobsonian reflector telescope mounted on an alt-azimuth rocker box. The telescope tube is represented by an open truss-tube assembly consisting of a black cylindrical mirror cell at the base, six thin silver vertical truss poles, and a black double-ring upper cage with an integrated focuser. The wooden-textured brown rocker box has two tall side walls and sits on a flat, square ground board, allowing full azimuth rotation. The entire optical tube assembly pivots on circular altitude trunnions nested within the rocker box sides.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a Dobsonian reflector telescope on an alt-az rocker box. The telescope should feature a lower mirror cell, an open-truss tube structure with silver poles, a double-ring upper cage, and circular altitude trunnions that pivot on a brown wooden-style rocker box, which itself rotates on a flat square ground board.
captions.factory: Construct the telescope assembly by defining three main parts: a ground board, a rocker box, and the optical tube assembly (OTA). Use a flat rectangular Box for the ground board. Build the rocker box using Box primitives for the bottom and upright side panels. For the OTA, model the lower mirror cell as a Cylinder, the truss poles as thin Cylinders arranged in a circular pattern, and the upper cage with two thin rings (created via concentric cylinder subtraction) connected by small vertical spacers. Add circular trunnion disks on the sides of the OTA, and define a continuous azimuth joint between the ground board and the rocker box, plus a revolute altitude joint between the rocker box and the OTA.
